# README banner

`banner.jpg` is the picture at the top of the README. It was generated locally with Z-Image Turbo (bf16) in ComfyUI: 1536x640, 9 steps, cfg 1.0, sampler res_multistep, scheduler simple, seed 1040714232, then resized to 1280x533 and saved as JPEG. The same prompt and seed give the same picture.

Prompt:

> a garden bed of identical rows where seeds sprout into plants that grow dice as fruit, same pattern repeated row after row, morning light, wide cinematic banner illustration, painterly digital art, soft volumetric light, rich but muted colour palette, detailed, storybook atmosphere, no text, no letters, no words, no logos, no watermark
